home.title: $HOME — the sync source
home.description: Everything the sandboxed agent needs for full local context. Config anchoring: ~/.config/opencode/** is always synced first-wave and path-verified after landing.
details: node_modules, target/ … via .syncignore (merged from both roots)

daemon.title: sync daemon (crates/cli)
daemon.description: The laptop-side long-lived process. One plain std thread per configured target: fsnotify events (debounced) and a periodic safety re-scan trigger sync passes; each pass re-dials through the blocking transport bridge.
details: fsnotify burst (500 ms debounce) · 60 s safety re-scan · sync_now
UI resolves go into local_resolutions for the next pass
the laptop owns the data plane (remote_driver semantics)

watch.title: fsnotify watcher
watch.description: Recursive watcher over the target root. Event bursts settle for debounce_ms before a pass; a periodic re-scan catches anything the events missed.

archive.title: archive + caches (vendored copia)
archive.description: The 3-way ancestor lives in a single archive file per pair (key = sandbox:root_remote). Atomic temp+fsync+rename, version-checked. Missing/corrupt/foreign ⇒ safe no-base: deletes can never be produced without a trusted base.
details: sandbox : root_remote — re-pointing a root yields a FRESH archive
a stale base once planned a mass laptop deletion (B looked like it deleted everything)
archive saved ONLY on full success + post-apply convergence

driver.title: bisync driver (crates/core)
driver.description: scan → 3-way reconcile → safety → apply → archive, wiring the six engine modules. v1 policy: TwoWaySafe + newest-wins-with-conflict-copy.
details: vendored copia 3-way table (reconcile.rs, MIT-attributed; Kani/Lean-proved upstream)
file-vs-file newest-wins by cached mtime; loser copied to <name>.sync-conflict-<epoch>-<side> on BOTH roots; dir/symlink/opaque ⇒ left untouched + reported
check_safety on the MERGED plan: >10k files or >50% of tree ⇒ halt — zero mutation, zero conflict copies
removals first, then materializations; symlink-aware, mode-bits only (never uid/gid)

proto.title: sync-proto — wire framing
proto.description: Handshake first so exec-transport banner noise fails loudly instead of corrupting frames. Frames are u32 BE length prefix + opaque body; bulk file content streams as raw bytes after the frame header, never inline.
details: u32 BE major/minor, exact match in v1 (drift ⇒ re-inject agent)
MAX_FRAME = 1 MiB — anything bigger is a protocol error
CacheChunk* → Scan → ScanBegin → ScanChunk* → CacheChunk* → ScanDone

transport.title: transports (plan §1 ladder)
transport.description: P2p (primary): libp2p stream over the VPS relay — the agent's PeerId is deterministically derived from (master key, sandbox_id), so the daemon dials <relay>/p2p-circuit/p2p/<agent-peer> with no DHT. OcExec (bootstrap/fallback): oc exec stdio, binary-safe non-tty, with agent auto-injection.
details: circuit boots the session → bounded DCUtR punch window → direct wins + circuit closed; 'staying relayed' on failure
daemon TOFU-pins the agent PeerId per sandbox and refuses a mismatch
direct vs relayed surfaced in the UI snapshot
probe = full handshake; stale/missing agent is re-uploaded + installed
kata policy blocks exec into CoCo pods — hence dial-OUT p2p as the real path

apihttp.title: localhost HTTP API
apihttp.description: Loopback-only (the daemon refuses any non-loopback bind — there is no auth on this surface). The daemon is the BFF: it holds the cluster credential and the P2P transports.
details: resolve · pause · resume · sync-now · dry-run · excludes

ui.title: PatternFly UI
ui.description: Standalone PatternFly app embedded in the daemon binary via rust-embed (assets from crates/cli/ui/dist). Reuses AgentStore patterns: listing YAML, engine client shape, graceful degradation.
details: wizard derives root_remote=/sandbox/<name> + qualified sandbox id
excludes editor rewrites config.toml (comments NOT preserved)
target snapshot, conflicts, halts, auto-provision notes

masterkey.title: master.key
masterkey.description: Per-sandbox master key — the same value the sandbox holds. 0600 file under ~/.config/sync-agent-pvc/ (or 64-hex env). Identity is derived from (master key, sandbox-id), so this one key powers every target while each gets its own peer identity.
details: chart Secret rendered at deploy time (never committed) → env SYNC_AGENT_MASTER_KEY

config.title: config.toml
config.description: Daemon config: [server] bind, [defaults] (relay, interval, debounce, master key, auto_provision), [[targets]] (name, sandbox, root, root_remote, excludes). Hot-reloaded: add/edit/remove targets without a restart.

vps.title: VPS — relay node
vps.description: A deliberately DUMB rendezvous: standard libp2p relay-v2 (circuit reservations + circuits) plus DCUtR hole-punch help. It holds no peer keys, keeps no per-sandbox state, and only ever sees noise-encrypted traffic. The fixed VPS IS the rendezvous — no DHT, no rendezvous protocol.
details: tcp + noise + yamux + relay(SERVER) + dcutr + identify
ed25519 keypair at /var/lib/sync-agent-relay/identity.ed25519 — PeerId is load-bearing
single static musl binary; stdout prints exactly one line: the PeerId

relay.title: sync-relay (tcp/4001)
relay.description: Rendezvous + FALLBACK only — never the steady-state data path. Each pass boots the session on the noise-encrypted relayed circuit, then DCUtR punches a DIRECT laptop⇄agent connection; when it lands the circuit is torn down and the sync stream runs direct. Punch window is bounded; on failure the session logs 'staying relayed' and keeps using the circuit.
details: DCUtR simultaneous connect → direct TCP, circuit closed
punch failed / window elapsed ⇒ data keeps riding the circuit
last_path() = direct | relayed, surfaced in the UI

cluster.title: OpenShift cluster (ocp5-1)
cluster.description: The Red Hat build of Agent Sandbox operator (v0.9.0) + OpenShell. One Helm chart (deploy/chart) renders the cluster-side artifacts via GitOps; images build in-cluster via BuildConfig/S2I and promote to quay.io/eformat.

route.title: OpenShell Route
route.description: The authenticated edge for sandbox lifecycle (create with --env-from, logs) and the exec fallback transport. Real sync traffic does NOT ride here — it is pure TCP libp2p to the VPS relay, which is why p2p targets never need cluster credentials.
details: the agent dials VPS:4001 — NetworkPolicy sandbox-egress-vps.yaml allows it

secret.title: k8s Secret — master key
secret.description: deploy/chart renders the Secret from --set at deploy time (the value is never committed). The sandbox consumes it as an environment variable.
details: the k8s driver's per-sandbox schema accepts PVC-only volumes — no secret/configmap volumes
key readable in the Sandbox CR env map (v1 spike-status exception, §9)

sandbox.title: OpenShell sandbox pod
sandbox.description: An AgentSandbox CR (kubernetes-sigs/agent-sandbox) backed by a PVC — never emptyDir. sync-agent p2p is the sandbox's MAIN PROCESS (not a sidecar): the chart sets the main-process spec, the supervisor spawns it, and its lifetime = sandbox lifetime (keeps phase Ready).
details: as a supervisor-spawned process it sits INSIDE the sandbox identity/policy regime
sync agent + sandbox agent share pod UID; mode bits only, umask 0644/0755, exec-bit propagation

agent.title: sync-agent p2p (in sandbox)
agent.description: The remote half. Dials OUT to the VPS relay and serves the PVC sync root over relayed/direct libp2p streams. Binds --root at startup — the root-match rail means P2P can never repoint it remotely.
details: serve (stdio) · install (versioned binary + GC) · p2p (daemon) · mcp
reports root, UID/GID + root perms — feeds status/UI diagnostics
is the protocol channel on exec transports; logs go to stderr

mcp.title: sync-agent mcp (M3.5)
mcp.description: Sandbox-side control-plane MCP server on stdio (rmcp 3.9), injected into OpenCode via the mcpServers block. MCP is the CONTROL plane only — never bulk data.
details: sync_status · sync_pause · sync_resume · sync_resolve_conflict · sync_now · sync_ignore_add
isError text the caller can read — never a thrown McpError for validation

syncstate.title: .sync-agent/sync-state.json
syncstate.description: Daemon-written per-sandbox sync state — the source sync_status reads. Lives in the scanner-skipped .sync-agent dir, so control state never enters the sync set.
details: last_sync_unix · paused · conflicts[] · applied/deleted/failed · problems[] · daemon_version
after every pass via Request::SyncReport (temp + fsync + rename)

ctrlreq.title: .sync-agent/control-requests.json
ctrlreq.description: Agent-written asks, fetched and cleared by the daemon's next sync pass. Fetch-and-clear is atomic on the agent side; unhonorable requests (e.g. a resolve for a path that no longer conflicts) are consumed and REPORTED as stale — no silent loops, no restore churn.
details: keep-local | keep-remote per path (winner propagates, loser dropped)

pvcroot.title: PVC root — /sandbox/<project>
pvcroot.description: Subpath policy ('subpaths always'): targets default to root_remote=/sandbox/<name> so the repo structure stays visible in the sandbox and multi-target root collisions are structurally impossible. The /sandbox top level holds only home infra + .sync-agent + project subdirs.
details: archive identity = sandbox : root_remote (re-point ⇒ fresh no-base archive)
agent binds its root at startup; hello.root ≠ root_remote ⇒ hard error
qualified ids 'sync-oc+<project>' — own peer/pin/archive, shared master.key

opencode.title: OpenCode agent (in sandbox)
opencode.description: The consumer of all of this: a coding agent running in the sandbox with its full $HOME context synced from the laptop. It self-serves sync state and conflict resolution through the injected MCP tools.
details: OpenCode-only harness: one catalog listing, opencode.json-format MCP injection
opencode.json baked into the derived image / seeded via workspace-init

pvc.title: PersistentVolumeClaim
pvc.description: The durable half of the pair: /sandbox IS the PVC, so synced state survives pod restarts and sandbox recycling. RWO, mounted into the sandbox workspace.

chart.title: deploy/chart (GitOps)
chart.description: ONE Helm chart for all cluster-side artifacts. Declares its vendored openshell subchart (lint-clean), and renders the master-key Secret + sandbox config at deploy time — secret values never land in git.
details: namespace · SCC RoleBinding · Route · egress NetworkPolicy · master-key Secret · sandbox config
BuildConfig/S2I binary builds from the laptop; digest-pinned after quay promotion

steps.text: 1. User edits files in $HOME
2. fsnotify event → watcher (debounce 500 ms)
3. bisync pass: load pair archive — corrupt/missing ⇒ safe no-base (no deletes)
4. ancestor + caches load from .sync-agent state
5. bootstrap dial: <relay>/p2p-circuit/p2p/<agent-peer>
6. noise-encrypted circuit — the session's first bytes (relay sees ciphertext only)
7. DCUtR punch lands → DIRECT laptop⇄agent path; circuit torn down (fallback: stays relayed)
8. TOFU pin: PeerId = derive(master.key, sandbox-id) must match the pin
9. MAGIC handshake + version 0.1 + Hello (root, UID/GID facts)
10. Scan: merge .syncignore (both roots) → quick-check warm path → FlatTree chunks
11. 3-way reconcile vs the ancestor — TwoWaySafe table (vendored copia cores)
12. conflicts: file-vs-file newest-wins + .sync-conflict copies; dir/symlink ⇒ untouched
13. check_safety on the merged plan (10k-file / 50% delete guard)
14. StageFile: raw payload bytes ride the DIRECT stream (digest-gated)
15. TransitionRun: removals, then materializations
16. changes land atomically on /sandbox/<project> (PVC-backed)
17. post-apply re-scan must prove both roots converged
18. archive re-saved ONLY on full success (next run sees our own writes)
19. SyncReport: the daemon pushes the run's state to the agent
20. agent persists sync-state.json (temp + fsync + rename)
21. HTTP API streams the new snapshot over SSE
22. User sees the pass land in the dashboard
1. OpenCode calls sync_status (rmcp 3.9 stdio JSON-RPC)
2. MCP server reads .sync-agent/sync-state.json (never part of the sync set)
3. status back: summary + compact JSON (last sync, conflicts, pending)
4. OpenCode calls sync_resolve_conflict(path, keep-local | keep-remote)
5. validate: the path must be a LIVE conflict (else error lists the set)
6. control-requests.json written (temp + fsync + rename)
7. next daemon pass re-dials — same ladder: relay rendezvous → DCUtR punch
8. ControlFetch{consume} rides the DIRECT session — fetch-and-clear atomic (relay = fallback)
9. pending requests return with the session
10. honored: resolutions → plan · ignore_add → .syncignore · pause → skip · sync_now → run
11. SyncReport: what was honored lands in sync-state.json
12. agent persists the updated state
13. next sync_status reflects the outcome — stale requests are reported, never looped
1. attach a target (wizard or POST /api/targets)
2. derive root_remote=/sandbox/<name> + qualified id <sandbox>+<name>
3. first pass dials: no agent serves that root ⇒ root-mismatch (never synced)
4. auto_provision + never-synced ⇒ provision via the exec fallback
5. exec fallback spawns in the pod (explicit kubeconfig required!)
6. mkdir /sandbox/<name>; reuse binary .sync-agent/agents/<ver> (sort -V)
7. spawn: sync-agent p2p --root /sandbox/<name>
8. qualified id <sandbox>+<name> + shared master.key ⇒ identity = (key, id)
9. re-dial ×3 / 4 s through the relay
10. same (key, id) ⇒ same PeerId ⇒ same TOFU pin
11. root-match rail: hello.root must equal root_remote (else hard error)
12. first bisync converges into the new root
13. config.toml qualified + persisted; UI notes the spawned agent
1. a pass dials the agent as usual
2. handshake answers — but is it OUR agent?
3. RAIL 1 — TOFU pin: PeerId ≠ pin (impostor or key rotation) ⇒ session refused
4. identity = derive(master.key, sandbox-id) — a key rotation trips the pin too
5. RAIL 2 — Hello reports the root the agent bound at startup
6. root-match rail: hello.root ≠ root_remote ⇒ hard error — P2P can never repoint a root remotely
7. RAIL 3 — reconcile plans the next mutation set
8. delete guard: >10k files or >50% of the tree ⇒ HALT (zero mutation, zero copies)
9. re-pointed root ⇒ fresh no-base archive: deletes suppressed until trust is rebuilt
10. every halt lands in the run report + UI
11. loud diagnostics: pin mismatch, root facts, remote UID, halt reason

actions.value: ⇄ direct connection up — relayed circuit closed

cycleState.value: conflict copy: idea.md.sync-conflict-…-B on both roots

mcp.label: ⑬ agent sees it — stale requests reported

actions.value: HALT: root mismatch — repointing is a human action
